description: Ultra-lightweight, high-performance chat formatting plugin built for Paper servers running Minecraft 1.21 up to 26+, supporting Java 21 through Java 25.
body:
# Advanced Chat Formatter (ACF)

**Advanced Chat Formatter (ACF)** is an ultra-lightweight, high-performance chat rendering solution built for modern Paper networks. It seamlessly bridges the gap between old-school server configurations and modern UI styling frameworks, allowing full cross-compatibility without breaking a sweat.

[![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/BLtoqzo7?style=for-the-badge&color=00AF5C&logo=modrinth&logoColor=white)](https://modrinth.com/mod/BLtoqzo7) [![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/web-aboutcapy.dev-brightgreen?style=for-the-badge&logo=icloud&logoColor=white)](https://aboutcapy.dev) [![Wiki](https://img.shields.io/badge/wiki-docs.aboutcapy.dev-blue?style=for-the-badge&logo=readme&logoColor=white)](https://docs.aboutcapy.dev/acf) 

## Features

* **MiniMessage:** Full compatibility with modern tags like `<rainbow>`, `<gradient:#ff0000:#00ff00>`, `<bold>`, and `<italic>`.
* **Legacy Codes:** Out-of-the-box support for classic standard ampersand styling (`&a`, `&l`, etc.).
* **Hex RGB Formats:** Automatically translates standard community color strings like `&#ff5555` and `{#ff5555}` into modern formats.
* **LuckPerms Meta Injection**
  Automatically hooks into LuckPerms to pull and display user group metadata, dynamically injecting player `prefixes` and `suffixes` cleanly into the chat layout.
* **Async Event Execution**
  Built entirely on Paper's modern `AsyncChatEvent` API. By offloading chat text parsing completely from the main server thread, ACF guarantees maximum performance and **0 TPS lag** even on masive servers.

## Configuration

ACF keeps things completely customizable and straightforward with a lightweight `config.yml`.

```yaml
# Placeholders: {name}, {displayname}, {message}, {world}, {prefix}, {suffix}
default-format: "{prefix}{displayname}{suffix}<dark_gray> »<reset> {message}"

messages:
  no-permission: "<red>You do not have permission to run this command."
  reload-success: "<green>ACF configuration reloaded successfully!"
```

## Commands & Permissions

ACF features smart, permission-aware **tab-completion** so administrators can effortlessly run commands.

| Command | Alias | Description | Permission Required |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/chatformatter reload` | `/cf reload` | Reloads the `config.yml` setup live. | `chatformatter.admin` |
